item.title: Commentary: Theodore Roosevelt’s descendants urge U.S. senators to protect the Boundary Waters
item.description: The purpose of this letter is to strongly recommend all senators vote against H.J. Res. 140, to ask you to work with President Trump to seek ways to permanently protect the Boundary Waters, and to send a unified message that America is still a land that relentlessly protects its greatest wilderness terrain. item.title: Steve Carney: The fine, icy art of deadsticking
item.description: Anglers often hear the term “deadsticking” which has gained in popularity in the past few years. It’s basically a passive presentation that requires zero effort but can produce fish when aggressive jigging tactics fail. Here is a primer on deadsticking. item.title: The anatomy of a successful public lands pheasant hunt
item.description: Last pheasant season is just a fond memory now. In my opinion, it was a good one. With our excellent public land base in Minnesota’s ringneck range, as well as habitat work by Pheasants Forever and a variety of federal, state and local partners (not to mention what is shaping up to be a mild winter in the pheasant range), next season is already on my mind. item.title: Dedicated Nobles County Pheasants Forever chapter achieves big public lands milestone in Minnesota
item.description: Volunteers and supporters gathered recently to celebrate the dedication of Pheasant Run 50, a 42-acre addition to the Ransom Ridge Wildlife Management Area complex. The parcel expands on the existing 413-acre public area and is about eight miles southwest of Worthington in Nobles County. item.title: Itchin’ for a brawl? Meet Lake Alexander’s bass, muskies in central Minnesota
item.description: When fishing experts use words such as stable, consistent, reliable, and productive to describe a lake, you can be confident that it’s full of fish-catching opportunities.
